ability.name: Earthen Blessings
ability.note: This Pokémon cannot win you the duel by moving to the goal point. This Pokémon may MP move through other Pokémon on the field. While this Pokémon is on the field, the start-of-turn Z-Move gauge increase of each player is boosted for each of that player's Pokémon that is affected by a special condition.

wheel.name: Elusive Master
wheel.note: You may move this Pokémon to the bench. When you do, change this Pokémon's form, if possible.

wheel.name: Smack Down
wheel.note: While the battle opponent is on the field, that Pokémon loses any Ability effects that allow it to MP move through other Pokémon.
